title: CoNP membership of the inner language
statement: Let $C_w,c_w\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet. The language of Boolean strings $w$ for which every Boolean string $v$ has the property that the pair encoding of $w$ and $v$ does not belong to the language of malformed or locally inconsistent encodings defined by the associated verifier is in coNP.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The statement depends on the elaborate, parameterized definition of badLang through atom evaluation and local checks; the payload does not supply an informal description of that language, so the verifier characterization here is necessarily compressed.
